hooks.statusMessage: Auto-merge do branch atual para main...
hooks.command: branch=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$branch" ] && [ "$branch" != "main" ]; then git fetch origin main >/dev/null 2>&1; if git push origin "HEAD:main" >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf '{"systemMessage":"Auto-merge: %s -> main concluido"}' "$branch"; else printf '{"systemMessage":"Auto-merge FALHOU: %s nao faz fast-forward em main; merge manual necessario"}' "$branch"; fi; fi; exit 0
